FILE
  BLOCK_COMMENT '/* a C style comment */'
  LOCAL_DEF
    local 'local'
    NAME_LIST
      NAME_DEF
        ID 'a'
    = '='
    EXPR_LIST
      BINARY_EXPR
        LITERAL_EXPR
          NUMBER '1'
        BLOCK_COMMENT '/* inline */'
        BINARY_OP
          + '+'
        LITERAL_EXPR
          NUMBER '2'
  BLOCK_COMMENT '/*\n  multi-line\n  comment\n*/'
  LOCAL_DEF
    local 'local'
    NAME_LIST
      NAME_DEF
        ID 'b'
    = '='
    EXPR_LIST
      BINARY_EXPR
        NAME_EXPR
          ID 'a'
        BINARY_OP
          // '//'
        LITERAL_EXPR
          NUMBER '2'
  SHORT_COMMENT '-- integer division, not a comment'
  LOCAL_DEF
    local 'local'
    NAME_LIST
      NAME_DEF
        ID 'c'
    = '='
    EXPR_LIST
      BINARY_EXPR
        NAME_EXPR
          ID 'a'
        BLOCK_COMMENT '/* nested /* is not nested */'
        BINARY_OP
          * '*'
        LITERAL_EXPR
          NUMBER '3'
  SHORT_COMMENT '--/* just a line comment'
  LOCAL_DEF
    local 'local'
    NAME_LIST
      NAME_DEF
        ID 'd'
    = '='
    EXPR_LIST
      LITERAL_EXPR
        STRING '"/* in a string */"'
